title: ContextEnvelope
description:
The Intent Context Envelope — `context.json` (ADR-0001 §2.2).

One envelope per authored unit at every altitude (intent · PR ·
campaign); reachable behind `IntentSidecar.context_ref` (a CAS pointer)
and the derived records' `envelope_ref`. See the module docs for the
naming map onto the frozen v1 `intent_id` fields.

Frozen by WP-F1 (ADR-0001, ratified 2026-06-10).

altitude.description: The altitude of the authored unit (intent | pr | campaign).

authorship.description: Provenance: who/what authored the unit (agents are ephemeral).

campaign.description:
Campaign key this unit belongs to; `null` when uncampaigned. Drives
subliminal grouping (the landing queue bundles PRs by campaign).

charter.description: The "why" — human-readable charter for the unit.

commit.description:
Git commit this unit enriches (the intent's commit; at higher
altitudes, the unit's landed/head commit).

constraints.description: Constraints the unit was authored under.

intent_id.description:
The authored-unit id at this envelope's altitude: the commit-level
intent id at `intent`, the PR id at `pr`, the campaign key at
`campaign` (ADR-0001 §2.2). See the module docs for how this maps
onto the frozen v1 `intent_id` fields (which name the landing unit).

parent_intents.description: Ids of parent intents this unit builds on.

snapshot.description: What the agent read / the environment it ran in.

tree_hash.description: Merkle tree hash of the unit's workspace snapshot.

verdicts_ref.description:
`cas:` ref to the adversarial panel verdicts (`VerdictObject`s);
`null` when no panel ran.

Altitude.description:
The altitude of the authored unit this envelope records (owner-directed
2026-06-10): `intent` = a commit (subagent-authored) · `pr` = a bundle of
intents (orchestrator/human session) · `campaign` = a bundle of PRs
(human-owned). Same envelope shape at every altitude.

oneOf.description: A commit — the hugr-native authored unit, authored by a subagent.

A PR — a bundle of intents; the envelope is the orchestrator-session
(or human-session) record that planned/dispatched/landed the bundle.
A campaign — a bundle of PRs in the landing queue, owned by a human.

agent_type.description:
Subagent type (e.g. `"implementer"`), or `"main"` for a top-level
(orchestrator / campaign) session.

operator.description: Human principal who dispatched the work.

spawn.description: The agent's spawn lineage and lifespan.

FileRead.description: A file the agent read, content-pinned (ADR-0001 §2.2 `snapshot.files_read`).

hash.description: Content hash of the file as read (e.g. `sha256:…`).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file read.

IntentMetrics.description:
Per-unit measurement (ADR-0001 §2.2 `metrics` / §2.3 per-intent): the
vocabulary of fleet accountability. `cost_usd` is derived COGS shown for
trust — NOT what the customer is billed (never a usage meter).

Frozen by WP-F1 (ADR-0001).

active_ms.description: Model + tool busy time, ms (excludes idle).

cost_usd.description: Derived COGS in USD; NOT what the customer is billed.

tokens.description: Token spend with the cache split.

Snapshot.description: What the agent read / the environment it ran in (ADR-0001 §2.2 `snapshot`).

prompt_ref.description:
`cas:` ref to the (redacted) prompt blob; `null` below the capture
level that stores it.

Spawn.description: The agent's lifespan + spawn lineage (agents spawn and die per intent).

born_at.description: Unix ms — when the agent run was born.

died_at.description: Unix ms — when the agent run died.

parent_run_id.description:
Run identifier of the orchestrator that spawned it; `null` for a
top-level (unspawned) session.

run_id.description: Run identifier of the agent run that authored the unit.

TokenCounts.description: Token spend with the cache split (ADR-0001 §2.2 `metrics.tokens`).

count.description: Number of calls to this tool.

Trajectory.description:
The trajectory at three altitudes (ADR-0001 §2.1): raw (forensic,
born → die) · task (mid-altitude "what happened") · summary (inline
digest). Tenant-private, redacted on the write path. Refs absent below
the repo capture level are `null`; consumers MUST tolerate nulls.

journal_ref.description:
`cas:` ref to the append-only `hugit-ledger` Journal — the
human-annotation track alongside the machine trajectory; `null` when
absent.

raw_transcript_ref.description:
`cas:` ref to the complete agent loop, born → die: every model turn,
every tool call + result, system/charter prompts (redacted).
Present at capture level `full`; `null` below.

redaction_policy.description:
Which redaction policy scrubbed secrets/PII before the blobs were
written (redaction is on the write path).

summary.description:
Inline LLM digest, a few sentences — for the drawer.
Present at capture level `task` and above; `null` below.

task_transcript_ref.description:
`cas:` ref to the task-scoped mid-altitude transcript: brief in,
plan/step progression, key decisions, result/handoff out.
Present at capture level `task` and above; `null` below.
